sources.academicSummary: A recognised bachelor is required; applicants outside theology/religious studies are welcome. Recommendations are requested from a church contact and an academic teacher or department.

Church and academic recommendations, an approximately 1,000-word study-purpose letter and at least two years since baptism are listed. Shorter two-year FT/four-year PT routes depend on prior theology/religious-studies study or the specified CUHK MA combination; do not infer automatic advanced entry.
A Chinese personal statement explaining motivation is requested; an interview may be required.

Healthcare/medical bachelor or assessed equivalent plus one year of work experience. Essential Cardiology is the accepting concentration; Advanced Cardiology Practice explicitly does not accept 2027/28 applications. Non-local and local deadlines differ.
Health/social-science honours degree or assessed professional equivalent. The programme admits biennially and states that new applications open in September 2026; do not extrapolate an annual cycle.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
Healthcare-related or biomedical-science bachelor, or an accepted equivalent, is specified.
Healthcare or a related professional bachelor, or an accepted equivalent, is specified.
Biomedical-science/related study or recognised Chinese-medicine coursework is preferred. A written test and interview may be requested; this is a four-year programme, not a one-year conversion MSc.
Quantitative ability is requested; programming interest is preferred. Academic history, experience, references and language are assessed; shortlisted applicants take an interview and written test.
Mathematics/statistics preparation is preferred. Academic history, experience, references and language are assessed; shortlisted applicants take an interview and written test.

Higher English results are PREFERRED: IELTS 7 or TOEFL 92/120 or 5/6, alongside the listed public-exam/English-medium alternatives. They are not a universal hard minimum above the general requirement. A 500-word English statement must address the selected communication stream and intended impact.

Programme English alternatives include IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79/120 or 4.5/6, Hong Kong/English-medium degrees and listed public examinations. Cantonese is preferred. A 500-word English statement about information sources and reliability is requested.

Higher English results (IELTS 7 or TOEFL 92/120 or 5/6) and listed alternatives are framed as PREFERENCES. A 500-word English reflection grounded in a personal AI encounter is requested, including disclosure of tools used in preparing it; the platform does not prepare application statements.
Programme English alternatives include IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79/120 or 4.5/6, Hong Kong/English-medium degrees and listed public examinations; institutional acceptance remains an assessed alternative.

Programme English alternatives include IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79/120 or 4.5/6 and listed degree/public-exam routes. A 500-word English statement about advertising and the division between human and AI work is requested; the source emphasises authentic personal reasoning.
Programme English alternatives include IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79/120 or 4.5/6, Hong Kong/English-medium degrees and listed public examinations; institutional acceptance remains an assessed alternative.

A pre-professional architecture degree is required. Application materials must ALSO be submitted through the School of Architecture platform; central submission alone is insufficient. Funding-category prices differ.
At least one year of relevant work experience is given PRIORITY, not a universal work-year minimum. Programme-specific application procedures and background assessment require confirmation.

An accredited bachelor, ideally in economics, public/social policy or a related field. Programme English: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 85/120 or 4.5/6, with listed English-medium/public-exam alternatives. This is a dual CUHK/Northwestern award with an overseas study component; delivery scope needs confirmation and optional extension charges are extra.

Seven years of work experience including five managerial years and a current senior-management position are stated. The general EMBA academic clause permits a bachelor or assessed professional equivalent; the taught-master Second-Class/average-B clause excludes EMBA. Residence/global-visit expenses are additional.

Seven years of work experience including five managerial years and a current senior-management position are stated. The general EMBA academic clause permits a bachelor or assessed professional equivalent; the taught-master Second-Class/average-B clause excludes EMBA. Residence/global-visit expenses are additional.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
A personal statement of at most one page should connect the programme with future plans and the applicant’s preparation.
Chinese-language/literature or related study is preferred. A Chinese personal statement and interview may be requested.

PGDE/equivalent preparation or relevant professional experience and service as a Chinese-language teacher are preferred. A related Chinese-language graduate working in a relevant field may also apply. An entrance test/interview is listed; experience is not a universal numeric minimum.
Putonghua proficiency and a statement of academic purpose are requested. Shortlisted applicants take an interview and written test.
A purpose statement of about 800 Chinese or 1,000 English words is requested; an interview may be required.

CV and a purpose/academic-interest statement are requested. Switching full-time/part-time mode after paying the application fee is not allowed. The page lists 28 February but separately mentions capacity-dependent consideration after 31 January; confirm the applicable cutoff rather than treating the wording as an extension.

Early-childhood/education certification and relevant preschool/education service are preferred. Applicants without professional experience may qualify through recognised equivalent specialist study. An entrance test/interview is listed.

English/language-related honours study, applied-linguistics knowledge and a 500-word goals statement are requested. IELTS 7 with each component 6.5, or TOEFL 100/120 or 5/6, is PREFERRED alongside English-medium/Hong Kong degree routes; do not turn that preference into a universal failure.

English/language-related honours study is normal, but other good honours degrees may be considered. English adequacy and literary interest are assessed. Submit a 500-word goals statement and a 1,000–1,500-word literary essay sample.
PGDE/equivalent preparation specialising in English teaching is preferred. An entrance test/interview is listed.
A 400–500-word English personal statement is requested through the official postgraduate application system; academic recognition and programme selection remain university decisions.

Submit a roughly 1,000-word Chinese/English purpose statement and 10–15 original artworks in a single PDF of at most 5 MB. Shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Contemporary Art Practice and Chinese Art Practice require an explicit stream declaration.
Some gender-studies knowledge and a 500-word purpose statement are requested. Applicants from varied backgrounds are considered.

CV and answers in English to two programme questions are requested. Switching study mode after the application fee is paid is prohibited. The February deadline and capacity-dependent wording after 31 January require reconciliation, not an assumed extension.
Submit a one-A4-page purpose statement in English or Japanese as PDF. An interview may be requested.
An academic-interest/purpose statement is requested; shortlisted applicants take an interview and written test.
An interview and a 300–500-word English personal statement are listed. Additional courses beyond the normative period incur additional charges.
A roughly 2,000-word Chinese/English motivation essay should describe philosophical preparation, interests and expectations.

Psychology bachelor with Second-Class honours OR average B, and eligibility for Hong Kong Psychological Society graduate membership, are listed. PGDE or relevant educational experience is preferred. Both a written test and interview are required; professional recognition remains for assessment.

This conversion programme specifies a NON-Psychology bachelor. A 400-word English statement and selection of Research or Applied Stream are required; a curricular Research Stream is not by itself an MPhil award.
Good honours degrees outside religious studies may also be considered; recognition and selection are assessed.
Education/counselling qualifications or experience and school/helping-profession backgrounds are preferred. An entrance test/interview is listed; no universal numeric employment floor is inferred.

Education qualification/experience and school-leadership or teaching service are preferred. Relevant recognised specialist courses may support applicants without professional experience. An entrance test/interview is listed.
A 400–500-word English personal statement is requested through the official postgraduate application system; academic recognition and programme selection remain university decisions.
A 400–500-word English personal statement is requested through the official postgraduate application system; academic recognition and programme selection remain university decisions.

A 500-word English statement, two confidential recommendations, transcripts with grading scheme, graduate degree proof and applicable Mainland qualification verifications are requested. The stated commencement date is 1 October 2026, not the central September default.

English or a related subject degree is requested; an entrance test/interview may apply. Applicants with a relevant degree OUTSIDE Hong Kong face the specific higher test route: IELTS 7 including writing 7, OR TOEFL 94/120 or 5/6 including writing 27/30 or 5/6. Degree location/applicability must be confirmed before applying those higher thresholds.
An interview may be requested. Departmental academic background, stream choices and any scholarship/helper eligibility require separate confirmation; awards are not automatic fee reductions.

GMAT/GRE is optional. Relevant full-time post-qualification work experience is preferred for the part-time route, not mandatory for all applicants. Full-time and part-time final cutoffs and prices differ.
Pharmacy/related degree and registered-pharmacist status are specified. Two confidential referee reports are required; employer referees are preferred. Local and non-local final deadlines differ.
PGDE/equivalent preparation or relevant professional experience is preferred; an entrance test/interview is listed. Published per-unit quotes are not programme totals.

An entrance test/interview may apply. Teaching practice takes place in Mainland schools and Putonghua proficiency is needed. Mainland/Putonghua-medium degrees are preferred. The stated Putonghua test level relates to obtaining Mainland teacher qualification after study, not an automatic professional licence.

A practising-law qualification, LLB/equivalent, OR a non-law bachelor with substantial law-related employment may support entry. Non-English-taught-and-assessed undergraduate study triggers the programme test route: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 88/120 or 4.5/6 (or assessed equivalent), obtained within two years before applying. A non-law degree is not automatically excluded.

A practising-law qualification, LLB/equivalent, OR a non-law bachelor with substantial law-related employment may support entry. Non-English-taught-and-assessed undergraduate study triggers the programme test route: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 88/120 or 4.5/6 (or assessed equivalent), obtained within two years before applying. A non-law degree is not automatically excluded.

Practising-law qualification, normally non-common-law LLB/equivalent, OR non-law bachelor with substantial law-related employment may support entry. Where undergraduate study was not taught AND assessed in English, IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 88/120 or 4.5/6 or assessed equivalent is required within two years before applying.

A practising-law qualification, LLB/equivalent, OR a non-law bachelor with substantial law-related employment may support entry. Non-English-taught-and-assessed undergraduate study triggers the programme test route: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 88/120 or 4.5/6 (or assessed equivalent), obtained within two years before applying. A non-law degree is not automatically excluded.

A practising-law qualification, LLB/equivalent, OR a non-law bachelor with substantial law-related employment may support entry. Non-English-taught-and-assessed undergraduate study triggers the programme test route: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 88/120 or 4.5/6 (or assessed equivalent), obtained within two years before applying. A non-law degree is not automatically excluded.

The LLM routes include practising-law qualification, LLB/equivalent, non-law bachelor with substantial legal employment, OR related history/sociology/politics/anthropology degree. Where relevant, English tests are IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 88/120 or 4.5/6 within two years before applying; acceptance of alternatives is assessed.

Registered-nurse status is required, with a bachelor normally at least Second-Class OR recognised nursing bachelor averaging B. An interview may be requested. This is distinct from the pre-registration nursing programme.

A recognised bachelor in any discipline normally at least Second-Class/equivalent, written English/Chinese, spoken English/Cantonese and Hong Kong Nursing Council entry conditions are listed. It is a three-year pre-registration route; completing the platform comparison does not establish professional eligibility.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
A 400–500-word English personal statement is requested through the official postgraduate application system; academic recognition and programme selection remain university decisions.

At least two years of FULL-TIME POST-QUALIFICATION work experience is stated. GMAT/GRE is optional. The central page currently lists two-year FT/three-year PT durations; department/intake confirmation is still needed rather than silently replacing them with a familiar duration.
Three years of post-qualification experience is PREFERRED, not a universal minimum. An entrance examination and interview are listed. Activity expenses are additional to the quoted tuition.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
At least one passed university course in calculus, probability, statistics or an approved equivalent is required. GMAT/GRE is optional.
Science/engineering or a related bachelor is specified; equivalence is assessed by the university.
A bachelor in statistics or a related subject with at least Second-Class honours is specified. No conversion from a numeric GPA to honours is made.

Engineering/science bachelor OR another bachelor followed by two years of relevant professional employment is listed. The two-year experience alternative is not imposed on engineering/science graduates.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.
Science, medical-science or engineering bachelor OR equivalent tertiary study with relevant professional employment is listed; recognition is individually assessed.
A related bachelor OR another degree with relevant employment can support consideration; the page does not establish a universal work-year cutoff.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.

Chinese Medicine specialisation accepts Chinese-medicine degree or the stated diploma plus Hong Kong legal registration. Acupuncture also allows medical/healthcare degrees and is PART-TIME ONLY. Applicants must declare the specialisation; a general full-time option does not establish access to Acupuncture.

Chinese medicine/pharmacy/clinical medicine/life sciences are listed, with pharmaceutical engineering, bioengineering, biomedical and chemical fields also considered. Other disciplines require relevant work and committee approval. Applicants from the specified non-Chinese-speaking degree locations need senior-secondary-or-higher Chinese examination evidence.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
Science/engineering or a related bachelor is specified; equivalence is assessed by the university.
The selected panel refers to general admissions and quota-dependent rolling review. The full-time and part-time central final dates differ; verify the chosen mode.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.
GMAT/GRE is optional. Two years of full-time post-qualification experience is PREFERRED for part-time study, not a universal minimum. Full-time and part-time final cutoffs and prices differ.
Medicine, science or engineering majors are PREFERRED, not an exclusive hard subject list.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
Three years in healthcare organisations/management is PREFERRED, not a universal minimum.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.
At least one year of relevant work experience is given PRIORITY, not a universal work-year minimum. Programme-specific application procedures and background assessment require confirmation.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.
Medical/nursing-related bachelor is specified. Academic record, experience and references are assessed; shortlisted candidates may be interviewed.
An interview may be requested. Departmental academic background, stream choices and any scholarship/helper eligibility require separate confirmation; awards are not automatic fee reductions.

Mathematics/related Second-Class honours study and teaching/education preparation are preferred. An entrance test/interview is listed. Strong mathematics graduates intending to teach are expressly welcome; teaching employment is not mandatory for all.

Medical-laboratory/biomedical-science degree routes OR Part I/II registered medical laboratory technologist status are listed; professional registration is an alternative, not an additional requirement for every degree holder.

Medical/healthcare/biomedical degree OR satisfactory completion of the specified musculoskeletal-medicine rehabilitation PGD is listed. Interview and assessment of record, employment, references and language may apply.

Priority is given to relevant nutrition/food/biomedical/education honours degrees or equivalent specialist tertiary/professional qualifications. Prioritised subjects are not converted into an exclusive major rejection.

LOCAL applicants should be registered midwives. NON-LOCAL applicants need the stated midwifery/nursing/healthcare-related degree or academic/professional equivalent. These category-specific conditions are not interchangeable; interviews and record/reference assessment may apply.
Science/engineering bachelor OR another bachelor with adequate physics preparation is listed. A non-science degree alone does not prove rejection or acceptance.
Working or playing a significant role in prehospital/emergency care is PREFERRED; no universal work-year threshold is stated.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.
Second-Class honours bachelor in business, science, finance, economics, engineering or a related subject, and an interview, are listed. A numeric GPA is not converted into honours.

The programme panel refers to general academic admissions; GMAT/GRE is optional. A strong test result can support selection, but its absence is not an automatic failure. Fees, optional study travel and capacity-dependent rounds need their own applicability checks.
Professional-qualification certificates and an English personal statement are requested; interview forms part of selection. Academic record, work experience, references and language are assessed.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
GMAT/GRE is optional. Three years of post-qualification full-time experience is PREFERRED for part-time study. Mode-specific fees and final cutoffs must not be mixed.
Applicants are interviewed by an admissions panel; programme academic background/equivalence needs confirmation.

Psychology bachelor/equivalent and Hong Kong Psychological Society graduate-membership eligibility are required, as are spoken Cantonese and written Chinese. Abnormal/neuropsychology and counselling study is preferred. CV, thesis abstract, self-description and the applicable repeat-application statement are requested. Supporting references share the deadline; local/non-local fees differ.
IELTS Academic 6.5 with EACH component at least 6.0, OR TOEFL 79/120 or 4.5/6, is stated. Indicate field of study and answer two programme questions; a faculty meeting may be requested.
A one-to-two-page statement of purpose is requested. Programme-specific selection and academic recognition remain for confirmation.

Psychology/related bachelor or accepted equivalent, overall GPA at least 3.0, a 750-word English career/research statement and supporting references are listed. The consulted panel does NOT identify the GPA maximum/original scale: retain the published 3.0 in notes and do not invent a 4.0-scale comparison.
A one-to-two-page statement of purpose is requested. Programme-specific selection and academic recognition remain for confirmation.
A 400–500-word English personal statement is requested through the official postgraduate application system; academic recognition and programme selection remain university decisions.

The selected programme entry panel refers to CUHK general admissions. A programme-specific undergraduate subject restriction was not established in this panel; departmental selection and equivalence remain to be confirmed.
Engineering, science or technology bachelor, or accepted equivalent.
Engineering, science or technology bachelor, or accepted equivalent.

Engineering/science/technology honours bachelor, the stated HKIE-related qualification or accepted equivalent. Other relevant qualifications plus suitable work experience may support applicants without honours. Interview or language assessment may be required; honours is not the sole possible route.

Engineering/science/technology honours bachelor, the stated HKIE-related qualification or accepted equivalent. Other relevant qualifications plus suitable work experience may support applicants without honours. Interview or language assessment may be required; honours is not the sole possible route.
Healthcare, IT, engineering or applied-science bachelor/equivalent. Relevant healthcare-related post-qualification employment is PREFERRED, not mandatory for all.
Nursing bachelor/equivalent AND current practice in a specialist field are specified. This advanced MSc is distinct from the pre-registration Master of Nursing.

A recognised bachelor is the academic prerequisite. Nursing Council registration eligibility additionally requires the detailed HKCEE/HKDSE-or-equivalent secondary subject/grade pattern, and fluency in written English/Chinese and spoken English/Cantonese. Those professional conditions need individual review and are not inferred from a bachelor, GPA or IELTS alone. Local/non-local fee formulas differ.
A recognised bachelor or equivalent in ANY discipline is explicitly accepted as the academic background; recognition, documents and selection still need assessment.

Any-subject bachelor/equivalent. English-teaching specialisation prefers English/communication study; professional-communication specialisation does not require it. Specific score routes are IELTS 7 or TOEFL iBT 96/120; eligible native/English-medium graduates may use departmental interview/written-test assessment. A corresponding higher 1–6 TOEFL threshold was not established; do not substitute the university minimum.

Any-subject bachelor/equivalent. English-teaching specialisation prefers English/communication study; professional-communication specialisation does not require it. Specific score routes are IELTS 7 or TOEFL iBT 96/120; eligible native/English-medium graduates may use departmental interview/written-test assessment. A corresponding higher 1–6 TOEFL threshold was not established; do not substitute the university minimum.

Any-subject bachelor/equivalent. English-medium-degree and eligible interview/written-test alternatives are listed. Score routes: IELTS 7 with writing/speaking at least 6.5, or TOEFL iBT 96/120. The specific higher 1–6 TOEFL threshold remains unconfirmed; no conversion is made.

Biological/life/chemical/biomedical/health science or engineering bachelor/related equivalent. One year of relevant work is PREFERRED; entry-scholarship honours criteria are not universal admission requirements. This is the 17004 route, not the separately held 17005 cross-region programme.
Science/engineering/related bachelor or equivalent. One year of relevant employment is PREFERRED; scholarship grades are not the admission floor.

A recognised bachelor is the stated academic basis. Subject-specific selection/documents remain for confirmation; a universal numeric GPA or work-year minimum was not established in the selected panel.
A recognised bachelor is requested; entry tests and/or interviews may be required. Only the master award is retained, not the neighbouring PGD.
A recognised bachelor is requested; entry tests and/or interviews may be required. Only the master award is retained, not the neighbouring PGD.
Good honours degree/equivalent and good Chinese-language knowledge are specified; the university assesses equivalence.
Good honours degree/equivalent and good Chinese-language knowledge are specified; the university assesses equivalence.

Fashion Practice normally requires fashion/textile/design study; another degree plus adequate practical fashion skill/experience may be considered. Digital Fashion Innovation also considers media/film/animation/game/digital-art degrees with suitable digital skill or creative-industry experience. Choose the relevant pathway and portfolio requirements; do not combine entry alternatives.

A recognised bachelor is the stated academic basis. Subject-specific selection/documents remain for confirmation; a universal numeric GPA or work-year minimum was not established in the selected panel.
Recognised bachelor/equivalent. Applicants doing guidance work in teaching, social work, counselling or HR are PREFERRED.
Social-work/social-science/related bachelor is specified. Relevant work is DESIRABLE, not a universal minimum.
A recognised bachelor or equivalent in ANY discipline is explicitly accepted as the academic background; recognition, documents and selection still need assessment.
Recognised bachelor. Social-science background and relevant social-policy/development work are PREFERRED.

Bachelor or higher in any discipline; the degree route explicitly has no work-experience minimum. Fashion experience is preferred. Mature applicants with more than ten years of fashion-industry experience form a separately assessed exception, not a universal condition. Exclude the PGD duration.
Recognised bachelor AND college-level/equivalent Chinese for non-native Chinese speakers. Shortlisted applicants are interviewed.
Recognised bachelor AND college-level/equivalent Chinese for non-native Chinese speakers. Shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

A recognised bachelor is the stated academic basis. Subject-specific selection/documents remain for confirmation; a universal numeric GPA or work-year minimum was not established in the selected panel.
The general Applied Psychology route specifies a Psychology-major bachelor; it must not borrow the broader related-discipline entry of the Diverse Learning Needs route.
The general Applied Psychology route specifies a Psychology-major bachelor; it must not borrow the broader related-discipline entry of the Diverse Learning Needs route.
Recognised bachelor/equivalent. Relevant employment is preferred but expressly NOT mandatory.

Select a design specialism and complete its interview/portfolio requirements. IBD and SSD list design/business/humanities/technology routes; ISD lists design/STEM or related communication/psychology/anthropology; TED lists spatial/environmental/related fields. Alternative tertiary/professional routes are individually assessed. IBD’s two-year experience is preferred, not universal. One shared major list cannot establish entry to all four specialisms.
Recognised bachelor/equivalent. The investment-management subcode additionally welcomes applicants with little/no work and may interview; it is a separate explicit route, not a second degree count.
Recognised bachelor/equivalent. The investment-management subcode additionally welcomes applicants with little/no work and may interview; it is a separate explicit route, not a second degree count.

Science bachelor, preferably physics, biological or health-related science; other qualifications are individually assessed. English/Cantonese communication, physiology/anatomy credits and imaging work are PREFERENCES, not universal hard requirements.
Science bachelor, preferably biochemistry, biological/life or health science. This two-year professional Master is distinct from the similarly named MSc.

Business bachelor OR non-business bachelor with acceptable foundational business coursework. The named professional memberships/PolyU MCG can support up to 18 transferred credits and a shorter PT route after assessment; this is not universal advanced entry. PGD fees/durations are excluded.
Recognised bachelor. Fieldwork and its separate pricing require attention; the master is not a PGD or automatic professional registration.

Recognised bachelor. Prior entrepreneurship or two years of relevant full-time technology/business/innovation work is PREFERRED. The stated ELC written-test alternative requires institutional assessment, not an assumed waiver.
Accounting/related bachelor OR equivalent professional qualification. One year of relevant employment is PREFERRED.
Bachelor degree. Business with computing preparation, computing, science and engineering backgrounds are preferred; applicants with little/no work are expressly welcome.
Engineering, computing, basic science, business or economics honours bachelor, or assessed equivalent.
Science/engineering honours bachelor or assessed equivalent. Relevant photonics/microelectronics industry experience is PREFERRED.

Physiotherapy bachelor/equivalent, preferably with one year of post-qualification experience, OR a relevant professional diploma plus TWO years of work and recent continuing education. The diploma-route experience is not imposed on every bachelor holder.

Rehabilitation/healthcare/related bachelor/equivalent, preferably with one year of rehabilitation experience, OR related professional diploma plus TWO years of work and recent continuing education. Preserve these alternatives.

Computing/computer science/engineering/information systems/mathematics/related bachelor OR another bachelor plus at least THREE years of relevant IT employment. Do not impose the three-year alternative on computing graduates or automatically reject other fields.

Relevant architecture/construction/building/property/project/IT bachelor is listed. Relevant professional corporate membership plus construction experience may support exceptional non-bachelor entry; recognition is individually assessed.

Computing/computer science/engineering/information systems/mathematics/related bachelor OR another bachelor plus at least THREE years of relevant IT employment. Do not impose the three-year alternative on computing graduates or automatically reject other fields.

Computing/computer science/engineering/information systems/mathematics/related bachelor OR another bachelor plus at least THREE years of relevant IT employment. Do not impose the three-year alternative on computing graduates or automatically reject other fields.

Engineering/science/technology honours bachelor, the stated HKIE-related qualification or accepted equivalent. Other relevant qualifications plus suitable work experience may support applicants without honours. Interview or language assessment may be required; honours is not the sole possible route.
Engineering/applied-science OR healthcare/closely related degree OR accepted equivalent. Relevant health-related post-qualification work is PREFERRED.

Computing/computer science/engineering/information systems/mathematics/related bachelor OR another bachelor plus at least THREE years of relevant IT employment. Do not impose the three-year alternative on computing graduates or automatically reject other fields.

Computing/computer science/engineering/information systems/mathematics/related bachelor OR another bachelor plus at least THREE years of relevant IT employment. Do not impose the three-year alternative on computing graduates or automatically reject other fields.
Engineering, basic science or closely related bachelor is specified; institutional recognition/equivalence is assessed.

Relevant building-services/mechanical/electrical honours degree/equivalent OR the stated professional membership plus building-services work. Relevant experience and employer support are advantageous, not universal compulsory sponsorship.

Bachelor or assessed academic/professional equivalent, preferably with one year of relevant work. A normally age-27-plus alternative accepts other postsecondary qualifications with SIX years of work including THREE managerial years; those are not universal bachelor-route minima.
Construction/real-estate/planning/architecture/environment-related honours degree or accepted academic/professional equivalent.
Construction/real-estate/planning/architecture/environment-related honours degree or accepted academic/professional equivalent.
Civil-engineering honours bachelor or equivalent, plus applicable university English requirements.
Civil-engineering honours bachelor or equivalent, plus applicable university English requirements.
Honours bachelor OR construction/real-estate-related bachelor OR relevant professional corporate membership. These alternatives must not be collapsed into a single honours-only route.

Computing/computer science/engineering/information systems/mathematics/related bachelor OR another bachelor plus at least THREE years of relevant IT employment. Do not impose the three-year alternative on computing graduates or automatically reject other fields.

Mathematics/statistics/computing/IT/engineering/science honours bachelor/equivalent; the data-science panel also lists economics. Another bachelor with adequate mathematics/IT preparation may be considered; no universal work-year requirement.

Mathematics/statistics/computing/IT/engineering/science honours bachelor/equivalent; the data-science panel also lists economics. Another bachelor with adequate mathematics/IT preparation may be considered; no universal work-year requirement.

Relevant food/nutrition/biology/health/science honours degree AND undergraduate physiology, biochemistry and principles-of-nutrition courses, each worth three credits or accepted equivalent. Course equivalence is assessed; a subject name alone is insufficient.

A recognised bachelor is the stated academic basis. Subject-specific selection/documents remain for confirmation; a universal numeric GPA or work-year minimum was not established in the selected panel.
